

```
POST /api/v1/reviews/{id}/rounds                      guardedAny(permDocWrite)
GET  /api/v1/reviews/{id}/rounds/{n}                  guardedAny(permDocRead)
GET  /api/v1/reviews/{id}/events?after=&timeout=      guardedAny(permDocRead)
```

`POST .../rounds` dispatches on the body: `verdict` set is a reviewer
round; `base_ref` set and no `verdict` is an author round; both or neither
is 422. `client` defaults to `cli`; `crit`, `web`, `cli`, `agent` are the
values the WL-REQ-1322 CHECK allows, and the handler refuses others with
422 before the CHECK does. Whether `web` stays allowed is the open decision
WL-1023 (WL-REQ-1322 and WL-REQ-1775 disagree); this task does not settle
it and no client in this series sends `web`. Observe
`rounds_total{subject,client}`, `verdicts_total{verdict,reviewer_kind}` and
`time_to_verdict_seconds` (`opened_at` to this round's `submitted_at`).

`GET .../events`: `after` is a `review_messages.seq`; the response is
`{"after": <seq>, "threads": [...], "messages": [...]}` holding everything
with `seq > after` plus threads whose status changed since; `timeout` is
seconds, capped at 60; nothing new by the deadline is 204. Poll loop per
Decisions. Query parameters are one `model.ReviewEventsParams`.

First handler test: reviewer `a` posts a round `{"verdict":"approved"}` with
an open `change_request` thread in the same body, 422 naming the thread;
`{"verdict":"approved"}` with a `note` thread, 201 and `rounds/1` reads back
`client=cli`, `focused=false`. Then a second test starts a long-poll with
`timeout=5` in a goroutine, posts a reply, and asserts the poll returns
within 2 s carrying the message.
